description: Compare game versions side by side, in the game's own terms first: the stats on its boards (glitchless_dashboard) and its own events per session, then the built-in measures it reports (frame time overall and per level, hitches/min, crash-free and error-free sessions, errors per session, level completion, rage-quit rate, deaths per session, geometry growth). Use it to confirm a fix or a design change after shipping a new version. Versions come in release order (when each first showed up at all, not in this window), so by default it compares the newest with the one before it, also while players of older versions still play. For a game on Steam, by "steam_branch" compares Steam branches instead (a beta against "public"), and by "steam_build" Steam builds: a and b are then branch names or build ids. By a session property ("class", "spender"; glitchless_events lists them) it compares that property's values the same way, the most sessions first (over 31 days or less): a and b are then values.

a.description: Baseline version, branch or build (default: the one before the newest)

b.description: New version, branch or build (default: newest)

by.description: What to compare (default version): steam_branch or steam_build (a game that uses Steamworks), or a session property's key, e.g. "class"

env.description: Only include sessions from this environment, e.g. "prod" (what the game passes to init; builds a developer runs usually send "dev")

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. Ignored with a key for one game.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24), as far back as the workspace keeps data on Glitchless Cloud (the answer says when it starts later than asked). Past 744 (31 days) answers are by day.

props.description: Only sessions with these session properties (what the game set with setProperties): { rank: "diamond" }, or a list of values for any of them, { rank: ["diamond", "master"] }; "(none)" keeps the sessions without one. glitchless_events lists the properties and their values. Read from the sessions, so over 31 days or less

service.description: Game service name (defaults to the most recently active game)

session_type.description: "user": players only; "tester": people on TestFlight and other test builds only; "synthetic": bots, playtests and store test devices only; "all" or unset: every session. Findings (glitchless_triage, and the overview's) read the production sessions of players unless env or session_type is given

name: glitchless_compare_versions
title: Compare versions
